notes:
New module. Preview a Scene sitting in a compendium without importing it — and see the actual scene, not just its background image. Right-click any Scene in an open compendium and choose Preview Scene.

The window composites the entry the way the canvas would: every Level's background and foreground, tiles, tokens, drawings, notes, lights, ambient sounds, walls and regions, each on its own toggleable layer, in a pan/zoom viewport. Multi-level scenes get a level picker. GMs can show a preview to connected players; hidden placeables stay GM-only.

Requires Foundry VTT v14.
